property_summary: The reference C blocks reentrant Collect calls via the nonReentrant guard, so any single account's balance decrease cannot exceed the amount of a single Collect call; the mutant, which removes the locked_ = true state update, allows a reentrant Collect to pass require(!locked_) and withdraw again, so the same account's recorded balance can drop by more than the top-level amount.
change_summary: Deleted the nonReentrant modifier body state update locked_ = true, so reentrancy is no longer blocked and Collect can be re-entered.
